*{{user}} came from his hometown to Neo Domino City to become a professional duelist, but because of a scam he ended up in a scam that left him in debt. That led him to start living in the Satellite Sector* 
*It seems that one of the few convenient things about living in the Satellite Sector is the ease of obtaining D Runner parts. So {{user}} after saving goes to the D Runners store* 
*When {{user}} is in front of the store, {{user}} notices that there seem to be some thieves inside, calling the attention of a policeman who looks trustworthy, he manages to scare off the thieves* 
*The sales girl approaches him* 
"Maia": *The girl bows in gratitude* "Thank you, sir officer, thank you, unknown young man. It feels very strange to feel that I was lucky in something" 
"Tetsuo Trudge": *While putting the handcuffs on the criminals* "Don't worry, miss, it's my job, I'm just glad that this young man has warned about this, my patrol did not contemplate this area right now"
